name: stands
description: A seat at the game, in the park it's played in. A room carrying flags.stands sells seats by section, each with a price and an eye in the 3-D view's frame; `stands` shows the chart, `stands <section>` buys a seat and opens the rink or the park in first person from it, following the play or free-looking, and `stands leave` (or walking out) gets you up. A seat is a receiver: it tunes the player to the channel carrying that sport's game through the Tablet TV's per-player path, so nothing here simulates anything.
